text:
ana: FYI seeing repeated p99 spikes for dedicated slices in rack r21 during evening window. traceroute shows traffic queuing on the rack egress switch but host tx queues also high.
tom: is this the noisy ML prep job from tenant X-22 again? Any disk io correlation?
ana: it's not X-22. different tenant (X-99). pattern: bursts ~400-700MB/s for 10-30s every 2-3m, coincides with large embedding jobs. GPU util stable. suspect egress saturation + TCP queue buildup.
li: can you post top output + ifstat? Also any NVMe write bursts?
ana: pasted small logs: `ifstat eth0: tx 620Mb/s, drops 2.4k in 20s` and `iostat nvme0n1: avgq-sz 0.02` -> not storage. switch counters show output-queue high on port.
ops-bot: alert: r21-egress-ramp high watermark triggered at 19:03 UTC.
tom: short-term mitigation: host-level policer (tc qdisc) to cap per-tenant egress at 300Mb/s. Less visible than proxy limit but still may add latency.
li: tc policing can be done per cgroup or veth. quick path: cgroup + fq_codel + tbf. cpu overhead minimal if we keep it simple.
ana: second option: prefer MIG-carve for that tenant so their jobs live on dedicated NVLink islands with less cross-traffic. downside: carving reduces packing efficiency and increases infra cost.
tom: also consider routing constraint: mark tenant traffic with DSCP and steer over alternate egress port with more headroom (requires switch QoS change). Net team involvement needed.
net-bot: note -> DSCP change requires config push to spine config and a maintenance window if applied cluster-wide.
li: cost tradeoffs: MIG carve (one GPU per tenant) -> lose 40% packing, estimated +18% monthly GPU spend for r21. Host policer -> near-zero spend but potential SLO hits for heavy tail.
ana: Action items: 1) tom -> roll out tc policer to r21 offenders (start with X-99) at 19:10, ramp to 100% in 3m. 2) net -> investigate DSCP steering feasibility and headroom on alternate egress. 3) li -> run quick cost model for MIG vs carve vs dedicated-slice fractional packing. 4) devex-bot -> prepare customer-facing note if tenant throttled.
tom: deploying policer now, will update.
ana: captured pcap and switch counters in s3://redwood-debug/r21-egress-17656.zip (internal).
net-bot: quick probe -> alternate port has ~30% spare capacity but requires qos map tweak. won't do global change without approval.
li: migration note: if we enable fractional dedicated slices (quarter-slice), packing increases but also increases number of tenants per host -> could amplify egress contention unless combined with per-tenant shaping. simulation required.
tom: polciers rolled out to X-99. monitoring dashboards show p95 improved, p99 trending down after 2m.
ana: suggested longer-term: add per-dedicated-slice network telemetry (tx-queue-occupancy, recent drop rates) into Console so product can set per-tenant isolation SLAs.
devex-bot: reminder -> don't share raw pcaps in public channels; use internal ACL or ticketing system.
li: do we want to trial DSCP steering in a canary rack? If so, net and infra sync.
ana: yes, canary r23 maybe. open item for next infra-net sync.
ops-bot: runbook: if host packet drops > 1k in 5m escalate to network oncall and consider immediate host policer.
tom: monitoring shows stable for 10m after throttle. closing loop here but will continue cost sims and propose infra changes in the design doc.
